title: Ayush Shetty Stuns Defending Champion Shi Yu Qi at Worlds
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty created a massive upset by defeating the defending world champion Shi Yu Qi on his World Championships debut.
summary: Ayush Shetty upset world champion Shi Yu Qi at the BWF World Championships, winning 21-14, 13-21, 21-19, showcasing skill and determination.

title: PV Sindhu Cruises Past Sophia Noble in World Championships Opener
indian_angle: India's premier shuttler PV Sindhu began her quest for a record sixth World Championships medal with a comfortable victory.
summary: PV Sindhu won her first match at the BWF World Championships, defeating Sophia Noble 21-7, 21-11, and aims for a historic sixth medal.

title: Simran Singhi's Journey to World Championships Debut
indian_angle: Indian women's doubles player Simran Singhi shares her inspiring story of overcoming challenges to compete at the World Championships.
summary: Simran Singhi opens up about her long journey to the 2026 Badminton World Championships, her partnership with Kavipriya Selvam and her dream of proving she belongs.

title: Sindhu Reflects on Past Finals, Aims for Home World Championships Success

summary: India No. 1 P. V. Sindhu is set to compete in the 10th World Championship of her decorated career but it will be the first time in front of home fans.

title: Antonsen Raises Concerns Over Delhi Air Quality for World Championships
indian_angle: World No. 4 Anders Antonsen's comments highlight ongoing concerns about air pollution in Delhi, the host city for the BWF World Championships.
summary: World No. 4 Antonsen has skipped the last three India Open tournaments citing air pollution in Delhi in January and hopes that the tournament is shifted to August.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati

summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently taking place at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
